text: If an unlearned person who pretends to be [paragraph continues] (worthy of the appellation) 'guest' comes to him, he shall give him a seat, water, and food, (thinking) 'I give it to a learned Brāhmaṇa.' Thus (the merit) of his (gift) becomes (as) great (as if a learned Brāhmaṇa had received it).

sanskrit_iast: yena kṛtāvasathaḥ syād atithir na taṃ pratyuttiṣṭhet pratyavarohed vā purastāc ced abhivāditaḥ |
meaning: येन कृतावसथः स्याद् अतिथिर् न तं प्रत्युत्तिष्ठेत् प्रत्यवरोहेद् वा पुरस्ताच् चेद् अभिवादितः ।
text: On the second and following days of the guest's stay, the host shall not rise or descend (from his couch) in order to salute his (guest), if he has been saluted before (on the first day).
He shall eat after his guests.
He shall not consume all the flavoured liquids in the house, so as to leave nothing for guests.
He shall not cause sweetmeats to be prepared for his own sake.
(A guest) who can repeat the (whole) Veda (together with the supplementary books) is worthy to receive a cow and the Madhuparka,

sanskrit_iast: ācārya ṛtvik snātako rājā vā dharmayuktaḥ |
meaning: आचार्य ऋत्विक् स्नातको राजा वा धर्मयुक्तः ।
text: (And also) the teacher, an officiating priest, a Snātaka, and a just king (though not learned in the Veda).

sanskrit_iast: ācāryāyartvije śvaśurāya rājña iti parisaṃvatsarād upatiṣṭhadbhyo gaur madhuparkaś ca |
meaning: आचार्यायर्त्विजे श्वशुराय राज्ञ इति परिसंवत्सराद् उपतिष्ठद्भ्यो गौर् मधुपर्कश् च ।
text: A cow and the Madhuparka (shall be offered) to the teacher, to an officiating priest, to a father-in-law, and to a king, if they come after a year has elapsed (since their former visit).

sanskrit_iast: dadhi madhusaṃsṛṣṭaṃ madhuparkaḥ payo vā madhusaṃsṛṣṭam |
meaning: दधि मधुसंसृष्टं मधुपर्कः पयो वा मधुसंसृष्टम् ।
text: The Madhuparka shall consist of curds mixed with honey, or of milk mixed with honey.
On failure (of these substances) water (mixed with honey may be used).
The Veda has six Aṅgas (auxiliary works).

sanskrit_iast: chandaḥ kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ jyotiṣaṃ niruktaṃ śīkṣā chandovicitir iti |
meaning: छन्दः कल्पो व्याकरणं ज्योतिषं निरुक्तं शीक्षा छन्दोविचितिर् इति ।
text: (The six auxiliary works are) the Kalpa (teaching the ritual) of the Veda, the treatises on grammar, astronomy, etymology, phonetics, and metrics.

sanskrit_iast: śabdārthārambhaṇānāṃ tu karmaṇāṃ samāmnāyasamāptau vedaśabdaḥ | tatra saṃkhyā vipratiṣiddhā |
meaning: शब्दार्थारम्भणानां तु कर्मणां समाम्नायसमाप्तौ वेदशब्दः । तत्र संख्या विप्रतिषिद्धा ।
text: (If any one should contend that) the term Veda (on account of its etymology, implying that which teaches duty or whereby one obtains spiritual merit) applies to the complete collection of (works which contain) rules for rites to be performed on the authority of precepts, (that, consequently, the Kalpa-sūtras form part of the Veda, and that thereby) the number (fixed above) for those (Aṅgas) is proved to be wrong,

sanskrit_iast: aṅgānāṃ tu pradhānair avyapadeśa iti nyāyavitsamayaḥ |
meaning: अङ्गानां तु प्रधानैर् अव्यपदेश इति न्यायवित्समयः ।
text: (Then we answer), All those who are learned in Mīmāṃsā are agreed that (the terms Veda, Brāhmaṇa, and the like, which are applied to) the principal (works), do not include the Aṅgas (the Kalpa-sūtras and the rest). he remembers at any time during dinner,

sanskrit_iast: atithiṃ nirākṛtya yatra gate bhojane smaret tato viramyopoṣya |
meaning: अतिथिं निराकृत्य यत्र गते भोजने स्मरेत् ततो विरम्योपोष्य ।
text: If he remembers at any time that he has refused a guest, he shall at once leave off eating and fast on that day,
And on the following day (he shall search for him), feast him to his heart's content, and accompany him (on his departure).
(If the guest) possesses a carriage, (he shall accompany him) as far as that.
Any other (guest he must accompany), until permission to return is given.
If (the guest) forgets (to give leave to depart), the (host) may return on reaching the boundary of his village.
To all (those who come for food) at (the end of) the Vaiśvadeva he shall give a portion, even to dogs and K aṇd ālas.
Some declare that he shall not give anything to unworthy people (such as K aṇd ālas).
A person who has been initiated shall not eat the leavings of women or of an uninitiated person.
All gifts are to be preceded by (pouring out) water.
(But gifts offered to priests) at sacrifices (are to be given) in the manner prescribed by the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: ye nityā bhāktikās teṣām anuparodhena saṃvibhāgo vihitaḥ |
meaning: ये नित्या भाक्तिकास् तेषाम् अनुपरोधेन संविभागो विहितः ।
text: The division of the food must be made in such a manner that those who receive daily portions (slaves) do not suffer by it.

sanskrit_iast: kāmam ātmānaṃ bhāryāṃ putraṃ voparundhyān na tv eva dāsakarmakaram |
meaning: कामम् आत्मानं भार्यां पुत्रं वोपरुन्ध्यान् न त्व् एव दासकर्मकरम् ।
text: At his pleasure, he may stint himself, his wife, or his children, but by no means a slave who does his work.

sanskrit_iast: tathā cātmano 'nuparodhaṃ kuryād yathā karmasv asamarthaḥ syāt |
meaning: तथा चात्मनो ऽनुपरोधं कुर्याद् यथा कर्मस्व् असमर्थः स्यात् ।
text: And he must not stint himself so much that he becomes unable to perform his duties.

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | aṣṭau grāsā muner bhakṣaḥ ṣoḍaśāraṇyavāsinaḥ | dvātriṃśataṃ gṛhasthasyāparimitaṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ | āhitāgnir anaḍvāṃś ca brahmacārī ca te trayaḥ | aśnanta eva sidhyanti naiṣāṃ siddhir anaśnatām iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । अष्टौ ग्रासा मुनेर् भक्षः षोडशारण्यवासिनः । द्वात्रिंशतं गृहस्थस्यापरिमितं ब्रह्मचारिणः । आहिताग्निर् अनड्वांश् च ब्रह्मचारी च ते त्रयः । अश्नन्त एव सिध्यन्ति नैषां सिद्धिर् अनश्नताम् इति ।
text: Now they quote also (the following two verses): 'Eight mouthfuls are the meal of an ascetic, sixteen that of a hermit living in the woods, thirty-two that of a householder, and an unlimited quantity that of a student. An Agnihotrin, a draught-ox, and a student, those three can do their work only if they eat; without eating (much), they cannot do it.'

sanskrit_iast: bhikṣaṇe nimittam ācāryo vivāho yajño mātāpitror bubhūrṣārhataś ca niyamavilopaḥ |
meaning: भिक्षणे निमित्तम् आचार्यो विवाहो यज्ञो मातापित्रोर् बुभूर्षार्हतश् च नियमविलोपः ।
text: The reasons for (which) begging (is permissible are), (the desire to collect the fee for) the teacher, (the celebration of) a wedding, (or of) a Śrauta-sacrifice, the desire to keep one's father and mother, and the (impending) interruption of ceremonies performed by a worthy man.
(The person asked for alms) must examine the qualities (of the petitioner) and give according to his power.

sanskrit_iast: indriyaprītyarthasya tu bhikṣaṇam animittam | na tad ādriyeta |
meaning: इन्द्रियप्रीत्यर्थस्य तु भिक्षणम् अनिमित्तम् । न तद् आद्रियेत ।
text: But if persons ask for alms for the sake of sensual gratification, that is improper; he shall not take heed of that.

sanskrit_iast: svakarma brāhmaṇasyādhyayanam adhyāpanam yajño yājanam dānaṃ pratigrahaṇam dāyād yaṃ śiloñchaḥ |
meaning: स्वकर्म ब्राह्मणस्याध्ययनम् अध्यापनम् यज्ञो याजनम् दानं प्रतिग्रहणम् दायाद् यं शिलोञ्छः ।
text: The lawful occupations of a Brāmaṇa are, studying, teaching, sacrificing for himself, officiating as priest for others, giving alms, receiving alms, inheriting, and gleaning corn in the fields;
And (he may live by taking) other things which belong to nobody.
(The lawful occupations) of a Kshatriya are the same, with the exception of teaching, officiating as priest, and receiving alms. (But) governing and fighting must be added.
(The lawful occupations) of a Vaiśya are the same as those of a Kshatriya, with the exception of governing and fighting. (But in his case) agriculture, the tending of cattle, and trade must be added.
He (shall) not choose (for the performance of a Śrauta-sacrifice) a priest who is unlearned in the Veda, nor one who haggles (about his fee).
(A priest) shall not officiate for a person unlearned in the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: yuddhe tad yogā yathopāyam upadiśanti tathā pratipattavyam |
meaning: युद्धे तद् योगा यथोपायम् उपदिशन्ति तथा प्रतिपत्तव्यम् ।
text: In war (Kshatriyas) shall act in such a manner as those order, who are learned in that (art of war).
The Āryas forbid the slaughter of those who have laid down their arms, of those who (beg for mercy) with flying hair or joined hands, and of fugitives.

sanskrit_iast: śāstrair adhigatānām indriyadaurbalyād vipratipannānāṃ śāstā nirveṣam upadiśed yathākarma yathoktam |
meaning: शास्त्रैर् अधिगतानाम् इन्द्रियदौर्बल्याद् विप्रतिपन्नानां शास्ता निर्वेषम् उपदिशेद् यथाकर्म यथोक्तम् ।
text: The spiritual guide shall order those who, (whilst) participating according to sacred law (in the rights of their caste), have gone astray through the weakness of their senses, to perform penances proportionate to (the greatness of) their sins, according to the precepts (of the Sm ri ti).

sanskrit_iast: tasya cec chāstram atipravarteran rajānaṃ gamayet |
meaning: तस्य चेच् छास्त्रम् अतिप्रवर्तेरन् रजानं गमयेत् ।
text: If (such persons) transgress their (Ā k ārya's) order, he shall take them before the king.
The king shall (send them) to his domestic priest, who should be learned in the law and the science of governing.
He shall order (them to perform the proper penances if they are) Brāhmaṇas.
He shall reduce them (to reason) by forcible means, excepting corporal punishment and servitude.

sanskrit_iast: itareṣāṃ varṇānām ā prāṇaviprayogāt samavekṣya teṣāṃ karmāṇi rājā daṇḍam praṇayet |
meaning: इतरेषां वर्णानाम् आ प्राणविप्रयोगात् समवेक्ष्य तेषां कर्माणि राजा दण्डम् प्रणयेत् ।
text: In the cases of (men of) other castes, the king, after having examined their actions, may punish them even by death.
And the king shall not punish on suspicion.

sanskrit_iast: suvicitaṃ vicityā daivapraśnebhyo rājā daṇḍāya pratipadyeta |
meaning: सुविचितं विचित्या दैवप्रश्नेभ्यो राजा दण्डाय प्रतिपद्येत ।
text: But having carefully investigated (the case) by means of questions (addressed to witnesses) and even of ordeals, the king may proceed to punish.
A king who acts thus, gains both (this and the next) world.
The road belongs to the king except if he meets a Brāhmaṇa.
But if he meets a Brāhmaṇa, the road belongs to the latter.

sanskrit_iast: yānasya bhārābhinihitasyāturasya striyā iti sarvair dātavyaḥ |
meaning: यानस्य भाराभिनिहितस्यातुरस्य स्त्रिया इति सर्वैर् दातव्यः ।
text: All must make way for a (laden) vehicle, for a person who carries a burden, for a sick man, for a woman and others (such as old men and infants).
And (way must be made), by the other castes, for those men who are superior by caste.
For their own welfare all men must make way for fools, outcasts, drunkards, and madmen.

sanskrit_iast: dharmacaryayā jaghanyo varṇaḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ varṇam āpadyate jātiparivṛttau |
meaning: धर्मचर्यया जघन्यो वर्णः पूर्वं पूर्वं वर्णम् आपद्यते जातिपरिवृत्तौ ।
text: In successive births men of the lower castes are born in the next higher one, if they have fulfilled their duties.

sanskrit_iast: adharmacaryayā pūrvo varṇo jaghanyaṃ jaghanyaṃ varṇam āpadyate jātiparivṛttau |
meaning: अधर्मचर्यया पूर्वो वर्णो जघन्यं जघन्यं वर्णम् आपद्यते जातिपरिवृत्तौ ।
text: In successive births men of the higher castes are born in the next lower one, if they neglect their duties.
If he has a wife who (is willing and able) to perform (her share of) the religious duties and who bears sons, he shall not take a second.
If a wife is deficient in one of these two (qualities), he shall take another, (but) before he kindles the fires (of the Agnihotra).

sanskrit_iast: ādhāne hi satī karmabhiḥ saṃbadhyate yeṣām etad aṅgam |
meaning: आधाने हि सती कर्मभिः संबध्यते येषाम् एतद् अङ्गम् ।
text: For a wife who assists at the kindling of the fires, becomes connected with those religious rites of which that (fire-kindling) forms a part.
He shall not give his daughter to a man belonging to the same family (Gotra),
Nor to one related (within six degrees) on the mother's or (the father's) side.

sanskrit_iast: brāhme vivāhe bandhuśīlaśrutārogyāṇi buddhvā prajāsahatvakarmabhyaḥ pratipādayec chaktiviṣayeṇālaṃkṛtya |
meaning: ब्राह्मे विवाहे बन्धुशीलश्रुतारोग्याणि बुद्ध्वा प्रजासहत्वकर्मभ्यः प्रतिपादयेच् छक्तिविषयेणालंकृत्य ।
text: At the wedding called Brāhma, he shall give away (his daughter) for bearing children and performing the rites that must be performed together (by a husband and his wife), after having enquired regarding (the bridegroom's) family, character, learning, and health, and after having given (to the bride) ornaments according to his power.
At the wedding called Ārsha, the bridegroom shall present to the father of the bride a bull and a cow.
At the wedding called Daiva, (the father) shall give her to an officiating priest, who is performing a Śrauta-sacrifice.
If a maiden and a lover unite themselves through love, that is called the Gāndharva-rite.

sanskrit_iast: śaktiviṣayeṇa dravyāṇi datvā vaheran sa āsuraḥ |
meaning: शक्तिविषयेण द्रव्याणि दत्वा वहेरन् स आसुरः ।
text: If the suitor pays money (for his bride) according to his ability, and marries her (afterwards), that (marriage is called) the Āsura-rite.
If the (bridegroom and his friends) take away (the bride), after having overcome (by force) her father (or relations), that is called the Rākshasa-rite.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ traya ādyāḥ praśastāḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ śreyān |
meaning: तेषां त्रय आद्याः प्रशस्ताः पूर्वः पूर्वः श्रेयान् ।
text: The first three amongst these (marriage-rites are considered) praiseworthy; each preceding one better than the one following.

sanskrit_iast: yathā yukto vivāhas tathā yuktā prajā bhavati |
meaning: यथा युक्तो विवाहस् तथा युक्ता प्रजा भवति ।
text: The quality of the offspring is according to the quality of the marriage-rite.
He shall not step on a spot which has been touched by the hand of a Brāhmaṇa, without having sprinkled it with water.
He shall not pass between a fire and a Brāhmaṇa,
Nor between Brāhmaṇas.
Or he may pass between them after having received permission to do so.

sanskrit_iast: agnim apaś ca na yugapad dhārayīta |
meaning: अग्निम् अपश् च न युगपद् धारयीत ।
text: He shall not carry fire and water at the same time.
He shall not carry fires (burning in) separate (places) to one (spot).

sanskrit_iast: pratimukham agnim āhriyamāṇam nāpratiṣṭhitaṃ bhūmau pradakṣiṇīkuryāt |
meaning: प्रतिमुखम् अग्निम् आह्रियमाणम् नाप्रतिष्ठितं भूमौ प्रदक्षिणीकुर्यात् ।
text: If, whilst he walks, fire is being carried towards him, he shall not walk around it with his right hand turned towards it, except after it has been placed on the ground.
He shall not join his hands on his back.

sanskrit_iast: svapann abhinimrukto nāśvān vāgyato rātrim āsīta | śvobhūta udakam upaspṛśya vācaṃ visṛjet |
meaning: स्वपन्न् अभिनिम्रुक्तो नाश्वान् वाग्यतो रात्रिम् आसीत । श्वोभूत उदकम् उपस्पृश्य वाचं विसृजेत् ।
text: If the sun sets whilst he sleeps, he shall sit up, fasting and silent, for that night. On the following morning he shall bathe and then raise his voice (in prayer).

meaning: स्वपन्न् अभ्युदितो नाश्वान् वाग्यतो ऽहस् तिष्ठेत् ।
text: If the sun rises whilst he is asleep, he shall stand during that day fasting and silent.

sanskrit_iast: ā tamitoḥ prāṇam āyacched ity eke |
meaning: आ तमितोः प्राणम् आयच्छेद् इत्य् एके ।
text: Some declare that he shall restrain his breath until he is tired.
And (he shall restrain his breath until he is tired) if he has had a bad dream,
Or if he desires to accomplish some object,
Or if he has transgressed some other rule.
(If he is) doubtful (whether) the result (of an action will be good or evil), he shall not do it.
(He shall follow) the same principle (if he is in doubt whether he ought) to study or not.
He shall not talk of a doubtful matter as if it were clear.

In the case of a person who slept at sunset, of one who slept at sunrise, of one who has black nails, or black teeth, of one who married a younger sister before the elder one was married, of one who married an elder sister whose younger sister had been married already, (of a younger brother who has kindled the sacred G ri hya-fire before his elder brother,) of one whose younger brother has kindled the sacred fire first, (of a younger brother who offers a Soma-sacrifice before his elder brother,) of an elder brother whose younger brother offered a Soma-sacrifice first, of an elder brother who marries or receives his portion of the inheritance after his younger brother, and of a younger brother who takes a wife or receives his portion of the inheritance before his elder brother,--penances ordained for crimes causing impurity, a heavier one for each succeeding case, must be performed.

sanskrit_iast: tac ca liṅgaṃ caritvoddhāryam ity eke |
meaning: तच् च लिङ्गं चरित्वोद्धार्यम् इत्य् एके ।
text: Some declare, that after having performed that penance, he shall remove its cause.

sanskrit_iast: savarṇāpūrvaśāstravihitāyāṃ yathartu gacchataḥ putrās teṣāṃ karmabhiḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
meaning: सवर्णापूर्वशास्त्रविहितायां यथर्तु गच्छतः पुत्रास् तेषां कर्मभिः संबन्धः ।
text: Sons begotten by a man who approaches in the proper season a woman of equal caste, who has not belonged to another man, and who has been married legally, have a right to (follow) the occupations (of their castes),

sanskrit_iast: pūrvavatyām asaṃskṛtāyāṃ varṇāntare ca maithune doṣaḥ |
meaning: पूर्ववत्याम् असंस्कृतायां वर्णान्तरे च मैथुने दोषः ।

sanskrit_iast: athāpy udāharanti | idānīm evāhaṃ janaka strīṇām īrṣyāmi no purā | yadā yamasya sādane janayituḥ putram abruvan | retodhāḥ putraṃ nayati paretya yamasādane | tasmād bhāryāṃ rakṣanti bibhyantaḥ pararetasaḥ | apramattā rakṣatha tantum etaṃ mā vaḥ kṣetre parabījāni vāpsuḥ | janayituḥ putro bhavati sāṃparāye moghaṃ vettā kurute tantum etam iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति । इदानीम् एवाहं जनक स्त्रीणाम् ईर्ष्यामि नो पुरा । यदा यमस्य सादने जनयितुः पुत्रम् अब्रुवन् । रेतोधाः पुत्रं नयति परेत्य यमसादने । तस्माद् भार्यां रक्षन्ति बिभ्यन्तः पररेतसः । अप्रमत्ता रक्षथ तन्तुम् एतं मा वः क्षेत्रे परबीजानि वाप्सुः । जनयितुः पुत्रो भवति सांपराये मोघं वेत्ता कुरुते तन्तुम् एतम् इति ।

sanskrit_iast: vivāhe duhitṛmate dānaṃ kāmyaṃ dharmārthaṃ śrūyate tasmād duhitṛmate 'dhirathaṃ śataṃ deyaṃ tan mithuyā kuryād iti | tasyāṃ krayaśabdaḥ saṃstutimātram | dharmād hi saṃbandhaḥ |
meaning: विवाहे दुहितृमते दानं काम्यं धर्मार्थं श्रूयते तस्माद् दुहितृमते ऽधिरथं शतं देयं तन् मिथुया कुर्याद् इति । तस्यां क्रयशब्दः संस्तुतिमात्रम् । धर्माद् हि संबन्धः ।

sanskrit_iast: jīvan putrebhyo dāyaṃ vibhajet samaṃ klībam unmattaṃ patitaṃ ca parihāpya |
meaning: जीवन् पुत्रेभ्यो दायं विभजेत् समं क्लीबम् उन्मत्तं पतितं च परिहाप्य ।
text: He should, during his lifetime, divide his wealth equally amongst his sons, excepting the eunuch, the mad man, and the outcast.
On failure of sons the nearest Sapiṇd a (takes the inheritance).

sanskrit_iast: tadabhāva ācārya ācāryābhāve 'ntevāsī hṛtvā tadartheṣu dharmakṛtyeṣu vopayojayet |
meaning: तदभाव आचार्य आचार्याभावे ऽन्तेवासी हृत्वा तदर्थेषु धर्मकृत्येषु वोपयोजयेत् ।
text: On failure of them the spiritual teacher (inherits); on failure of the spiritual teacher a pupil shall take (the deceased's wealth), and use it for religious works for the (deceased's) benefit, or (he himself may enjoy it);
Or the daughter (may take the inheritance).
On failure of all (relations) let the king take the inheritance.
Some declare, that the eldest son alone inherits.

sanskrit_iast: deśaviśeṣe suvarṇam kṛṣṇā gāvaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaumaṃ jyeṣṭhasya |
meaning: देशविशेषे सुवर्णम् कृष्णा गावः कृष्णं भौमं ज्येष्ठस्य ।
text: In some countries gold, (or) black cattle, (or) black produce of the earth is the share of the eldest.
The chariot and the furniture in the house are the father's (share).
According to some, the share of the wife consists of her ornaments, and the wealth (which she may have received) from her relations.
That (preference of the eldest son) is forbidden by the Śāstras.

sanskrit_iast: manuḥ putrebhyo dāyaṃ vyabhajad ity aviśeṣeṇa śrūyate |
meaning: मनुः पुत्रेभ्यो दायं व्यभजद् इत्य् अविशेषेण श्रूयते ।
text: For it is declared in the Veda, without (marking) a difference (in the treatment of the sons): Manu divided his wealth amongst his sons.

sanskrit_iast: athāpi tasmāj jyeṣṭhaṃ putraṃ dhanena niravasāyayantīty ekavac chrūyate |
meaning: अथापि तस्माज् ज्येष्ठं पुत्रं धनेन निरवसाययन्तीत्य् एकवच् छ्रूयते ।
text: Now the Veda declares also in conformity with (the rule in favour of the eldest son) alone: They distinguish the eldest by (a larger share of) the heritage.

sanskrit_iast: athāpi nityānuvādam avidhim āhur nyāyavido yathā tasmād ajāvayaḥ paśūnāṃ saha carantīti tasmāt snātakasya mukhaṃ rebhāyatīva tasmād bastaś ca śrotriyaś ca strīkāmatamāv iti |
meaning: अथापि नित्यानुवादम् अविधिम् आहुर् न्यायविदो यथा तस्माद् अजावयः पशूनां सह चरन्तीति तस्मात् स्नातकस्य मुखं रेभायतीव तस्माद् बस्तश् च श्रोत्रियश् च स्त्रीकामतमाव् इति ।
text: (But to this plea in favour of the eldest I answer): Now those who are acquainted with the interpretation of the law declare a statement of facts not to be a rule, as for instance (the following): 'Therefore amongst cattle, goats and sheep walk together;' (or the following), 'Therefore the face of a learned Brāhmaṇa (a Snātaka) is, as it were, resplendent;' (or), 'A Brāhmaṇa who has studied the Vedas (a Śrotriya) and a he-goat evince the strongest sexual desires.'
Therefore all (sons) who are virtuous inherit.

sanskrit_iast: yas tv adharmeṇa dravyāṇi pratipādayati jyeṣṭho 'pi tam abhāgaṃ kurvīta |
meaning: यस् त्व् अधर्मेण द्रव्याणि प्रतिपादयति ज्येष्ठो ऽपि तम् अभागं कुर्वीत ।
text: But him who expends money unrighteously, he shall disinherit, though he be the eldest son.
No division takes place between husband and wife.
For, from the time of marriage, they are united in religious ceremonies,
Likewise also as regards the rewards for works by which spiritual merit is acquired,
And with respect to the acquisition of property.

sanskrit_iast: na hi bhartur vipravāse naimittike dāne steyam upadiśanti |
meaning: न हि भर्तुर् विप्रवासे नैमित्तिके दाने स्तेयम् उपदिशन्ति ।
text: For they declare that it is not a theft if a wife spends money on occasions (of necessity) during her husband's absence.
By this (discussion) the law of custom, which is observed in (particular) countries or families, has been disposed of.

sanskrit_iast: mātuś ca yonisaṃbandhebhyaḥ pituś cā saptamāt puruṣād yāvatā vā saṃbandho jñāyate teṣāṃ preteṣūdakopasparśanaṃ garbhān parihāpyāparisaṃvatsarān |
meaning: मातुश् च योनिसंबन्धेभ्यः पितुश् चा सप्तमात् पुरुषाद् यावता वा संबन्धो ज्ञायते तेषां प्रेतेषूदकोपस्पर्शनं गर्भान् परिहाप्यापरिसंवत्सरान् ।
text: On account of the blood relations of his mother and (on account of those) of his father within six degrees, or, as far as the relationship is traceable, he shall bathe if they die, excepting children that have not completed their first year.
On account of the death of the latter the parents alone bathe,
And those who bury them.
If a wife or one of the chief Gurus (a father or Ā k ārya) die, besides, fasting (is ordained from the time at which they die) up to the same time (on the following day).
(In that case) they shall also show the (following) signs of mourning:

sanskrit_iast: keśān prakīrya pāṃsūn opyekavāsaso dakṣiṇāmukhāḥ sakṛd upamajjayottīryopaviśanti |
meaning: केशान् प्रकीर्य पांसून् ओप्येकवाससो दक्षिणामुखाः सकृद् उपमज्जयोत्तीर्योपविशन्ति ।
text: Dishevelling their hair and covering themselves with dust (they go outside the village), and, clothed with one garment, their faces turned to the south, stepping into the river they throw up water for the dead once, and then, ascending (the bank), they sit down.
This (they repeat) thrice.

sanskrit_iast: tatpratyayam udakam utsicyāpratīkṣā grāmam etya yat striya āhus tat kurvanti |
meaning: तत्प्रत्ययम् उदकम् उत्सिच्याप्रतीक्षा ग्रामम् एत्य यत् स्त्रिय आहुस् तत् कुर्वन्ति ।
text: They pour out water consecrated in such a manner that the dead will know it (to be given to them). Then they return to the village without looking back, and perform those rites for the dead which (pious) women declare to be necessary.
Some declare, that these same (observances) shall also be kept in the case (of the death) of other (Sapiṇd as).
At all religious ceremonies, he shall feed Brāhmaṇas who are pure and who have (studied and remember) the Veda.

sanskrit_iast: deśataḥ kālataḥ śaucataḥ samyak pratigrahītṛta iti dānāni pratipādayati |
meaning: देशतः कालतः शौचतः सम्यक् प्रतिग्रहीतृत इति दानानि प्रतिपादयति ।
text: He shall distribute his gifts at the proper places, at the proper times, at the occasion of purificatory rites, and to proper recipients.

sanskrit_iast: yasyāgnau na kriyate yasya cāgraṃ na dīyate na tad bhoktavyam |
meaning: यस्याग्नौ न क्रियते यस्य चाग्रं न दीयते न तद् भोक्तव्यम् ।
text: That food must not be eaten of which (no portion) is offered in the fire, and of which no portion is first given (to guests).
No food mixed with pungent condiments or salt can be offered as a burnt-offering.
Nor (can food) mixed with bad food (be used for a burnt-oblation).

sanskrit_iast: ahaviṣyasya homa udīcīnam uṣṇaṃ bhasmāpohya tasmiñ juhyāt tad hutam ahutaṃ cāgnau bhavati |
meaning: अहविष्यस्य होम उदीचीनम् उष्णं भस्मापोह्य तस्मिञ् जुह्यात् तद् हुतम् अहुतं चाग्नौ भवति ।
text: If (he is obliged to offer) a burnt-offering of food unfit for that purpose, he shall take hot ashes from the northern part of his fire and offer the food in that. That oblation is no oblation in the fire.
A female shall not offer any burnt-oblation,
Nor a child, that has not been initiated.
Infants do not become impure before they receive the sacrament called Annaprāśana (the first feeding).
Some (declare, that they cannot become impure) until they have completed their first year,
Or, as long as they cannot distinguish the points of the horizon.
The best (opinion is, that they cannot be defiled) until the initiation has been performed.
For at that (time a child) according to the rules of the Veda obtains the right (to perform the various religious ceremonies).
That ceremony is the limit (from which the capacity to fulfil the law begins).
And the Sm ri ti (agrees with this opinion).

sanskrit_iast: saha devamanuṣyā asmiṃl loke purā babhūvuḥ | atha devāḥ karmabhir divaṃ jagmur ahīyanta manuṣyāḥ | teṣāṃ ye tathā karmāṇy ārabhante saha devair brahmaṇā cāmuṣmiṃl loke bhavanti | athaitan manuḥ śrāddhaśabdaṃ karma provāca |
meaning: सह देवमनुष्या अस्मिंल् लोके पुरा बभूवुः । अथ देवाः कर्मभिर् दिवं जग्मुर् अहीयन्त मनुष्याः । तेषां ये तथा कर्माण्य् आरभन्ते सह देवैर् ब्रह्मणा चामुष्मिंल् लोके भवन्ति । अथैतन् मनुः श्राद्धशब्दं कर्म प्रोवाच ।
text: Formerly men and gods lived together in this world. Then the gods in reward of their sacrifices went to heaven, but men were left behind. Those men who perform sacrifices in the same manner as the gods did, dwell (after death) with the gods and Brahman in heaven. Now (seeing men left behind), Manu revealed this ceremony, which is designated by the word Śrāddha (a funeral-oblation).
And (thus this rite has been revealed) for the salvation of mankind.

sanskrit_iast: tatra pitaro devatā brāhmaṇās tv āhavanīyārthe |
meaning: तत्र पितरो देवता ब्राह्मणास् त्व् आहवनीयार्थे ।
text: At that (rite) the Manes (of one's father, grandfather, and great-grand father) are the deities (to whom the sacrifice is offered). But the Brāhmaṇas, (who are fed,) represent the Āhavanīya-fire.
That rite must be performed in each month.
The afternoon of (a day of) the latter half is preferable (for it).
The last days of the latter half (of the month) likewise are (preferable to the first days).

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣv evāparapakṣasyāhassu kriyamāṇe pitṛṛn prīṇāti | kartus tu kālābhiniyamāt phalaviśeṣaḥ |
meaning: सर्वेष्व् एवापरपक्षस्याहस्सु क्रियमाणे पितृऋन् प्रीणाति । कर्तुस् तु कालाभिनियमात् फलविशेषः ।
text: (A funeral-oblation) offered on any day of the latter half of the month gladdens the Manes. But it procures different rewards for the sacrificer according to the time observed.

meaning: प्रथमे ऽहनि क्रियमाणे स्त्रीप्रायम् अपत्ये जायते ।
text: If it be performed on the first day of the half-month, the issue (of the sacrificer) will chiefly consist of females.
(Performed on the second day it procures) children who are free from thievish propensities.
(If it is performed) on the third day children will be born to him who will fulfil the various vows for studying (portions of the Veda).
(The sacrificer who performs it) on the fourth day becomes rich in small domestic animals.

sanskrit_iast: pañcame pumāṃsaḥ | bahvapatyo na cānapatyaḥ pramīyate |
meaning: पञ्चमे पुमांसः । बह्वपत्यो न चानपत्यः प्रमीयते ।
text: (If he performs it) on the fifth day, sons (will be born to him). He will have numerous and distinguished offspring, and he will not die childless.
(If he performs it) on the sixth day, he will become a great traveller and gambler.
(The reward of a funeral-oblation performed) on the seventh day is success in agriculture.
(If he performs it) on the eighth day (its reward is) prosperity
(If he performs it) on the ninth day (its reward consists in) one-hoofed animals.
(If he performs it) on the tenth day (its reward is) success in trade.
(If he performs it) on the eleventh day (its reward is) black iron, tin, and lead.
(If he performs a funeral-oblation) on the twelfth day, he will become rich in cattle.

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśe bahuputro bahumitro darśanīyāpatyaḥ | yuvamāriṇas tu bhavanti |
meaning: त्रयोदशे बहुपुत्रो बहुमित्रो दर्शनीयापत्यः । युवमारिणस् तु भवन्ति ।
text: (If he performs it) on the thirteenth day, he will have many sons (and) many friends, (and) his offspring will be beautiful. But his (sons) will die young.
(If he performs it) on the fourteenth day (its reward is) success in battle.
(If he performs it) on the fifteenth day (its reward is) prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: tatra dravyāṇi tilamāṣā vrīhiyavā āpo mūlaphalāni |
meaning: तत्र द्रव्याणि तिलमाषा व्रीहियवा आपो मूलफलानि ।
text: The substances (to be offered) at these (sacrifices) are sesamum, māsha, rice, yava, water, roots, and fruits.

sanskrit_iast: snehavati tv evānne tīvratarā pitṛṛṇāṃ prītir drāghīyāṃsaṃ ca kālam |
meaning: स्नेहवति त्व् एवान्ने तीव्रतरा पितृऋणां प्रीतिर् द्राघीयांसं च कालम् ।
text: But, if food mixed with fat (is offered), the satisfaction of the Manes is greater, and (lasts) a longer time,
Likewise, if money, lawfully acquired, is given to worthy (persons).
Beef satisfies (the Manes) for a year,
Buffalo's (meat) for a longer (time) than that.

sanskrit_iast: etena grāmyāraṇyānāṃ paśūnāṃ māṃsaṃ medhyaṃ vyākhyātam |
meaning: एतेन ग्राम्यारण्यानां पशूनां मांसं मेध्यं व्याख्यातम् ।
text: By this (permission of the use of buffalo's meat) it has been declared that the meat of (other) tame and wild animals is fit to be offered.
(If) rhinoceros' meat (is given to Brāhmaṇas seated) on (seats covered with) the skin of a rhinoceros, (the Manes are satisfied) for a very long time.
(The same effect is obtained) by (offering the) flesh (of the fish called) Śatabali,
And by (offering the) meat of the (crane called) Vārdhrāṇasa.

sanskrit_iast: prayataḥ prasannamanāḥ sṛṣṭo bhojayed brāhmaṇān brahmavido yonigotramantrāntevāsyasaṃbandhān |
meaning: प्रयतः प्रसन्नमनाः सृष्टो भोजयेद् ब्राह्मणान् ब्रह्मविदो योनिगोत्रमन्त्रान्तेवास्यसंबन्धान् ।
text: Pure, with composed mind and full of ardour, he shall feed Brāhmaṇas who know the Vedas, and who are not connected with him by marriage, blood relationship, by the relationship of sacrificial priest and sacrificer, or by the relationship of (teacher and) pupil.

sanskrit_iast: guṇahānyāṃ tu pareṣāṃ samudetaḥ sodaryo 'pi bhojayitavyaḥ |
meaning: गुणहान्यां तु परेषां समुदेतः सोदर्यो ऽपि भोजयितव्यः ।
text: If strangers are deficient in the (requisite) good qualities, even a full brother who possesses them, may be fed (at a Śrāddha).
(The admissibility of) pupils (and the rest) has been declared hereby.
Now they quote also (in regard to this matter the following verse):

sanskrit_iast: saṃbhojanī nāma piśācabhikṣā naiṣā pitṛṛn gacchati nota devān | ihaiva sā carati kṣīṇapuṇyā śālāntare gaur iva naṣṭavatsā |
meaning: संभोजनी नाम पिशाचभिक्षा नैषा पितृऋन् गच्छति नोत देवान् । इहैव सा चरति क्षीणपुण्या शालान्तरे गौर् इव नष्टवत्सा ।
text: The food eaten (at a sacrifice) by persons related to the giver is, indeed, a gift offered to the goblins. It reaches neither the Manes nor the gods. Losing its power (to procure heaven), it errs about in this world as a cow that has lost its calf runs into a strange stable.

sanskrit_iast: ihaiva saṃbhuñjatī dakṣiṇā kulāt kulaṃ vinaśyatīti |
meaning: इहैव संभुञ्जती दक्षिणा कुलात् कुलं विनश्यतीति ।
text: The meaning (of the verse) is, that gifts which are eaten (and offered) mutually by relations, (and thus go) from one house to the other, perish in this world.
If the good qualities (of several persons who might be invited) are equal, old men and (amongst these) poor ones, who wish to come, have the preference.
On the day before (the ceremony) the (first) invitation (must be issued).
On the following day the second invitation takes place.
(On the same day also takes place) the third invitation (which consists in the call to dinner).
Some declare, that every act at a funeral sacrifice must be repeated three times.

sanskrit_iast: yathā prathamam evaṃ dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca |
meaning: यथा प्रथमम् एवं द्वितीयं तृतीयं च ।
text: As (the acts are performed) the first time, so they must be repeated) the second and the third times.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣu vṛtteṣu sarvataḥ samavadāya śeṣasya grāsāvarārdhyaṃ prāśnīyād yathoktam |
meaning: सर्वेषु वृत्तेषु सर्वतः समवदाय शेषस्य ग्रासावरार्ध्यं प्राश्नीयाद् यथोक्तम् ।
text: When all (the three oblations) have been offered, he shall take a portion of the food of all (three), and shall eat a small mouthful of the remainder in the manner described (in the G ri hya-sūtra).
But the custom of the Northerners is to pour into the hands of the Brāhmaṇas, when they are seated on their seats, (water which has been taken from the water-vessel.)

sanskrit_iast: uddhriyatām agnau ca kriyatām ity āmantrayate |
meaning: उद्ध्रियताम् अग्नौ च क्रियताम् इत्य् आमन्त्रयते ।
text: (At the time of the burnt-offering which is offered at the beginning of the dinner) he addresses the Brāhmaṇas with this Mantra: 'Let it be taken out, and let it be offered in the fire.'

sanskrit_iast: kāmam uddhriyatāṃ kāmam agnau kriyatām ity attisṛṣṭa uddharej juhuyāc ca |
meaning: कामम् उद्ध्रियतां कामम् अग्नौ क्रियताम् इत्य् अत्तिसृष्ट उद्धरेज् जुहुयाच् च ।
text: (They shall give their permission with this Mantra): 'Let it be taken out at thy pleasure, let it be offered in the fire at thy pleasure.' Having received this permission, he shall take out (some of the prepared food) and offer it.

sanskrit_iast: śvabhir apapātraiś ca śrāddhasya darśanaṃ paricakṣate |
meaning: श्वभिर् अपपात्रैश् च श्राद्धस्य दर्शनं परिचक्षते ।
text: They blame it, if dogs and Apapātras are allowed to see the performance of a funeral-sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: śvitraḥ śipiviṣṭaḥ paratalpagāmy āyudhīyaputraḥ śūdrotpanno brāhmaṇyām ity ete śrāddhe bhuñjānāḥ paṅktidūṣaṇā bhavanti |
meaning: श्वित्रः शिपिविष्टः परतल्पगाम्य् आयुधीयपुत्रः शूद्रोत्पन्नो ब्राह्मण्याम् इत्य् एते श्राद्धे भुञ्जानाः पङ्क्तिदूषणा भवन्ति ।
text: The following persons defile the company if they are invited to a funeral-sacrifice, viz. a leper, a bald man, the violator of another man's bed, the son of a Brāhmaṇa who follows the profession of a Kshatriya, and the son of (a Brāhmaṇa who by marrying first a Śūdra wife had himself become) a Śūdra, born from a Brāhmaṇa woman.

sanskrit_iast: trimadhus trisuparṇas triṇāciketaś caturmedhaḥ pañcāgnir jyeṣṭhasāmago vedādhyāyy anūcānaputraḥ śrotriya ity ete śrāddhe bhuñjānāḥ paṅktipāvanā bhavanti |
meaning: त्रिमधुस् त्रिसुपर्णस् त्रिणाचिकेतश् चतुर्मेधः पञ्चाग्निर् ज्येष्ठसामगो वेदाध्याय्य् अनूचानपुत्रः श्रोत्रिय इत्य् एते श्राद्धे भुञ्जानाः पङ्क्तिपावना भवन्ति ।
text: The following persons sanctify the company if they eat at a funeral-sacrifice, viz. one who has studied the three verses of the Veda containing the word 'Madhu,' each three times; one who has studied the part of the Veda containing the word 'Suparṇa' three times; a Triṇā k iketa; one who has studied the Mantras required for the four sacrifices (called Aśvamedha, Purushamedha, Sarvamedha, and Pit ri medha); one who keeps five fires; one who knows the Sāman called G yesh th a; one who fulfils the duty of daily study; the son of one who has studied and is able to teach the whole Veda with its Aṅgas, and a Śrotriya.
He shall not perform (any part of) a funeral sacrifice at night.
After having begun (a funeral-sacrifice), he shall not eat until he has finished it.
(He shall not perform a funeral-sacrifice at night), except if an eclipse of the moon takes place.

sanskrit_iast: vilayanaṃ mathitaṃ piṇyākaṃ madhu māṃsaṃ ca varjayet |
meaning: विलयनं मथितं पिण्याकं मधु मांसं च वर्जयेत् ।
text: He shall avoid butter, butter-milk, oil-cake, honey, meat.
And black grain (Such as kulittha), food given by Śūdras, or by other persons, whose food is not considered fit to be eaten.

sanskrit_iast: ahaviṣyam anṛtaṃ krodhaṃ yena ca krodhayet | smṛtim icchan yaśo medhāṃ svargaṃ puṣṭiṃ dvādaśaitāni varjayet |
meaning: अहविष्यम् अनृतं क्रोधं येन च क्रोधयेत् । स्मृतिम् इच्छन् यशो मेधां स्वर्गं पुष्टिं द्वादशैतानि वर्जयेत् ।
text: And food unfit for oblations, speaking an untruth, anger, and (acts or words) by which he might excite anger. He who desires a (good) memory, fame, wisdom, heavenly bliss, and prosperity, shall avoid these twelve (things and acts);

sanskrit_iast: adhonābhy uparijānv ācchādya triṣavaṇam udakam upaspṛśann anagnipakvavṛttir acchāyopagaḥ sthānāsanikaḥ saṃvatsaram etad vrataṃ caret | etad aṣṭācatvāriṃśat saṃmitam ity ācakṣate |
meaning: अधोनाभ्य् उपरिजान्व् आच्छाद्य त्रिषवणम् उदकम् उपस्पृशन्न् अनग्निपक्ववृत्तिर् अच्छायोपगः स्थानासनिकः संवत्सरम् एतद् व्रतं चरेत् । एतद् अष्टाचत्वारिंशत् संमितम् इत्य् आचक्षते ।
text: Wearing a dress that reaches from the navel to the knees, bathing morning, noon, and evening, living on food that has not been cooked at a fire, never seeking the shade, standing (during the day), and sitting (during the night), he shall keep this vow for one year. They declare, that (its merit) is equal to that of a studentship continued for forty-eight years.
(Now follows) the daily funeral-oblation.

sanskrit_iast: bahir grāmāc chucayaḥ śucau deśe saṃskurvanti |
meaning: बहिर् ग्रामाच् छुचयः शुचौ देशे संस्कुर्वन्ति ।
text: Outside the village pure (men shall) prepare (the food for that rite) in a pure place.
New vessels are, used for that,

sanskrit_iast: yair annaṃ saṃskriyate yeṣu ca bhujyate |
meaning: यैर् अन्नं संस्क्रियते येषु च भुज्यते ।
text: In which the food is prepared, and out of which it is eaten.
And those (vessels) he shall present to the (Brāhmaṇas) who have been fed.
And he shall feed (Brāhmaṇas) possessed of all (good qualities).
And he shall hot give the residue (of that funeral-dinner) to one who is inferior to them in good qualities.
Thus (he shall act every day) during a year.
The last of these (funeral-oblations) he shall perform, offering a red goat.
And let him cause an altar to be built, concealed (by a covering and outside the village).
Let him feed the Brāhmaṇas on the northern half of that.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayān paśyati brāhmaṇāṃś ca bhuñjānān māne ca pitṛṛn ity upadiśanti |
meaning: उभयान् पश्यति ब्राह्मणांश् च भुञ्जानान् माने च पितृऋन् इत्य् उपदिशन्ति ।
text: They declare, that (then) he sees both the Brāhmaṇas who eat and the Manes sitting on the altar.
After that he may offer (a funeral-sacrifice once a month) or stop altogether.
For (by appearing on the altar) the Manes signify that they are satisfied by the funeral offering.
Under the constellation Tishya he who desires prosperity,

sanskrit_iast: gaurasarṣapāṇāṃ cūrṇāni kārayitvā taiḥ pāṇipādaṃ prakṣālya mukhaṃ karṇau prāśya ca yad vāto nātivāti tadāsano 'jinaṃ bastasya prathamaḥ kalpo vāgyato dakṣiṇāmukho bhuñjīta |
meaning: गौरसर्षपाणां चूर्णानि कारयित्वा तैः पाणिपादं प्रक्षाल्य मुखं कर्णौ प्राश्य च यद् वातो नातिवाति तदासनो ऽजिनं बस्तस्य प्रथमः कल्पो वाग्यतो दक्षिणामुखो भुञ्जीत ।
text: Shall cause to be prepared powder of white mustard-seeds, cause his hands, feet, ears, and mouth to be rubbed with that, and shall eat (the remainder). If the wind does not blow too violently, he shall eat sitting, silent and his face turned towards the south, on a seat (facing the) same (direction)the first alternative is the skin of a he-goat.

sanskrit_iast: anāyuṣyaṃ tv evaṃmukhasya bhojanaṃ mātur ity upadiśanti |
meaning: अनायुष्यं त्व् एवंमुखस्य भोजनं मातुर् इत्य् उपदिशन्ति ।
text: But they declare, that the life of the mother of that person who eats at this ceremony, his face turned in that direction, will be shortened.
A vessel of brass, the centre of which is gilt, is best (for this occasion).
And nobody else shall eat out of that vessel.
He shall make a lump of as much (food) as he can swallow (at once).
(And he shall) not scatter anything (on the ground).
He shall not let go the vessel (with his left hand);
Or he may let it go.
He shall swallow the whole mouthful at once, introducing it, together with the thumb, (into the mouth.)
He shall make no noise with his mouth (whilst eating).
And he shall not shake his right hand (whilst eating).

sanskrit_iast: ācamya cordhvau pāṇī dhārayed ā prodakībhāvāt |
meaning: आचम्य चोर्ध्वौ पाणी धारयेद् आ प्रोदकीभावात् ।
text: After he (has eaten and) sipped water, he shall raise his hands, until the water has run off (and they have become dry).
After that he shall touch fire.
And (during this ceremony) he shall not eat in the day-time anything but roots and fruit.
And let him avoid Sthālīpāka-offerings, and food offered to the Manes or to the Gods.
He shall eat wearing his upper garment over his left shoulder and under his right arm.

sanskrit_iast: naiyyamikaṃ tu śrāddhaṃ snehavad eva dadyāt |
meaning: नैय्यमिकं तु श्राद्धं स्नेहवद् एव दद्यात् ।
text: At the (monthly) Śrāddha which must necessarily be performed, he must use (food) mixed with fat.
The first (and preferable) alternative (is to employ) clarified butter and meat.
On failure (of these), oil of sesamum, vegetables, and (similar materials may be used).

sanskrit_iast: maghāsu cādhikaṃ śrāddhakalpena sarpir brāhmaṇān bhojayet |
meaning: मघासु चाधिकं श्राद्धकल्पेन सर्पिर् ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेत् ।
text: And under the asterism Maghā he shall feed the Brāhmaṇas more (than at other times) with (food mixed with) clarified butter, according to the rule of the Śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast: māsiśrāddhe tilānāṃ droṇaṃ droṇaṃ yenopāyena śaknuyāt tenopayojayet |
meaning: मासिश्राद्धे तिलानां द्रोणं द्रोणं येनोपायेन शक्नुयात् तेनोपयोजयेत् ।
text: At every monthly Śrāddha he shall use, in whatever manner he may be able, one droṇa of sesamum.

sanskrit_iast: samudetāṃś ca bhojayen na cātadguṇāyocchiṣṭam dadyuḥ |
meaning: समुदेतांश् च भोजयेन् न चातद्गुणायोच्छिष्टम् दद्युः ।
text: And he shall feed Brāhmaṇas endowed with all (good qualities), and they shall not give the fragments (of the food) to a person who does not possess the same good qualities (as the Brāhmaṇas).

sanskrit_iast: udagayana āpūryamāṇapakṣasyaikarātram avarārdhyam upoṣya tiṣyeṇa puṣṭikāmaḥ sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā mahārājam iṣṭvā tena sarpiṣmatā brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayitvā puṣṭyarthena siddhiṃ vācayīta |
meaning: उदगयन आपूर्यमाणपक्षस्यैकरात्रम् अवरार्ध्यम् उपोष्य तिष्येण पुष्टिकामः स्थालीपाकं श्रपयित्वा महाराजम् इष्ट्वा तेन सर्पिष्मता ब्राह्मणं भोजयित्वा पुष्ट्यर्थेन सिद्धिं वाचयीत ।
text: He who desires prosperity shall fast in the half of the year when the sun goes to the north, under the constellation Tishya, in the first half of the month, for (a day and) a night at least, prepare a Sthālīpāka-offering, offer burnt-oblations to Kubera (the god of riches), feed a Brāhmaṇa with that (food prepared for the Sthālīpāka) mixed with clarified butter, and make him wish prosperity with (a Mantra) implying prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: evam ahar ahar ā parasmāt tiṣyāt |
meaning: एवम् अहर् अहर् आ परस्मात् तिष्यात् ।
text: This (rite he shall repeat) daily until the next Tishya(-day).

sanskrit_iast: padā pādasya prakṣālanam adhiṣṭhānaṃ ca varjayet |
meaning: पदा पादस्य प्रक्षालनम् अधिष्ठानं च वर्जयेत् ।

text: And let him spend money on worthy (persons or objects).

sanskrit_iast: yantā cātīrthe yato na bhayaṃ syāt |
meaning: यन्ता चातीर्थे यतो न भयं स्यात् ।
text: And let him not give anything to an unworthy (person), of whom he does not stand in fear.
And let him conciliate men (by gifts or kindness).
And he may enjoy the pleasures which are not forbidden by the holy law.
(Acting) thus he conquers both worlds.

sanskrit_iast: catvāra āśramā gārhasthyam ācāryakulaṃ maunaṃ vānaprasthyam iti |
meaning: चत्वार आश्रमा गार्हस्थ्यम् आचार्यकुलं मौनं वानप्रस्थ्यम् इति ।
text: There are four orders, viz. the order of householders, the order of students, the order of ascetics, and the order of hermits in the woods.

sanskrit_iast: teṣu sarveṣu yathopadeśam avyagro vartamānaḥ kṣemaṃ gacchati |
meaning: तेषु सर्वेषु यथोपदेशम् अव्यग्रो वर्तमानः क्षेमं गच्छति ।
text: If he lives in all these four according to the rules (of the law), without allowing himself to be disturbed (by anything), he will obtain salvation.
The duty to live in the teacher's house after the initiation is common to all of them.
Not to abandon sacred learning (is a duty common) to all.

sanskrit_iast: buddhvā karmāṇi yat kāmayeta tad ārabheta |
meaning: बुद्ध्वा कर्माणि यत् कामयेत तद् आरभेत ।
text: Having learnt the rites (that are to be performed in each order), he may perform what he wishes.

sanskrit_iast: yathā vidyārthasya niyama etenaivāntam anūpasīdata ācāryakule śarīranyāso brahmacāriṇaḥ |
meaning: यथा विद्यार्थस्य नियम एतेनैवान्तम् अनूपसीदत आचार्यकुले शरीरन्यासो ब्रह्मचारिणः ।
text: Worshipping until death (and living) according to the rule of a (temporary) student, a (professed) student may leave his body in the house of his teacher.
Now (follow the rules) regarding the ascetic (Saṃnyāsin).
Only after (having fulfilled) the duties of that (order of students) he shall go forth (as an ascetic), remaining chaste.
For him (the Saṃnyāsin) they prescribe the following rules).

sanskrit_iast: anagnir aniketaḥ syād aśarmāśaraṇo muniḥ | svādhyāyaivotsṛjamāno vācaṃ grāme prāṇavṛttiṃ pratilabhyāniho 'namutraś caret |
meaning: अनग्निर् अनिकेतः स्याद् अशर्माशरणो मुनिः । स्वाध्यायैवोत्सृजमानो वाचं ग्रामे प्राणवृत्तिं प्रतिलभ्यानिहो ऽनमुत्रश् चरेत् ।
text: He shall live without a fire, without a house, Without pleasures, without protection. Remaining silent and uttering speech only on the occasion of the daily recitation of the Veda, begging so much food only in the village as will sustain his life, he shall wander about neither caring for this world nor for heaven.
It is ordained that he shall wear clothes thrown away (by others as useless).
Some declare that he shall go naked.

sanskrit_iast: satyānṛte sukhaduḥkhe vedān imaṃ lokam amuṃ ca parityajyātmānam anvicchet |
meaning: सत्यानृते सुखदुःखे वेदान् इमं लोकम् अमुं च परित्यज्यात्मानम् अन्विच्छेत् ।
text: Abandoning truth and falsehood, pleasure and pain, the Vedas, this world and the next, he shall seek the Ātman.
(Some say that) he obtains salvation if he knows (the Ātman).
(But) that (opinion) is opposed to the Śāstras.

sanskrit_iast: buddhe cet kṣemaprāpaṇam ihaiva na duḥkham upalabheta |
meaning: बुद्धे चेत् क्षेमप्रापणम् इहैव न दुःखम् उपलभेत ।
text: (For) if salvation were obtained by the knowledge of the Ātman alone, then he ought not to feel any pain even in this (world).
Thereby that which follows has been declared.
Now (follow the rules regarding) the hermit living in the woods.
Only after (completing) that (studentship) he shall go forth, remaining chaste.

sanskrit_iast: ekāgnir aniketaḥ syād aśarmāśaraṇo muniḥ | svādhyāya evotsṛjamāno vācam |
meaning: एकाग्निर् अनिकेतः स्याद् अशर्माशरणो मुनिः । स्वाध्याय एवोत्सृजमानो वाचम् ।

text: A dress of materials procured in the woods (skins or bark) is ordained for him.

sanskrit_iast: tato mūlaiḥ phalaiḥ parṇais tṛṇair iti vartayaṃś caret |
meaning: ततो मूलैः फलैः पर्णैस् तृणैर् इति वर्तयंश् चरेत् ।
text: Then he shall wander about, sustaining his life by roots, fruits, leaves, and grass.
In the end (he shall live on) what has become detached spontaneously.

meaning: ततो ऽपो वायुम् आकाशम् इत्य् अभिनिश्रयेत् ।
text: Next he shall live on water, (then) on air, then on ether.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām uttara uttaraḥ saṃyogaḥ phalato viśiṣṭaḥ |
meaning: तेषाम् उत्तर उत्तरः संयोगः फलतो विशिष्टः ।
text: Each following one of these modes of subsistence is distinguished by a (greater) reward.
Now some (teachers) enjoin for the hermit the successive performance (of the acts prescribed for the several orders).

sanskrit_iast: vidyāṃ samāpya dāraṃ kṛtvāgnīn ādhāya karmāṇy ārabhate somāvarārdhyāni yāni śrūyante |
meaning: विद्यां समाप्य दारं कृत्वाग्नीन् आधाय कर्माण्य् आरभते सोमावरार्ध्यानि यानि श्रूयन्ते ।
text: After having finished the. study of the Veda, having taken a wife and kindled the sacred fires, he shall begin the rites, which end with the Soma-sacrifices, (performing) as many as are prescribed in the revealed texts.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhān kṛtvā sadāraḥ saprajaḥ sahāgnibhir bahir grāmād vaset |
meaning: गृहान् कृत्वा सदारः सप्रजः सहाग्निभिर् बहिर् ग्रामाद् वसेत् ।
text: (Afterwards) he shall build a dwelling, and dwell outside the village with his wife, his children, and his fires,
Or (he may live) alone.
He shall support himself by gleaning corn.
And after that he shall not any longer take presents.
And he shall sacrifice (only) after having bathed (in the following manner):

sanskrit_iast: śanair apo 'bhyaveyād abhighnann abhimukham ādityam udakam upaspṛśet |
meaning: शनैर् अपो ऽभ्यवेयाद् अभिघ्नन्न् अभिमुखम् आदित्यम् उदकम् उपस्पृशेत् ।
text: He shall enter the water slowly, and bathe without beating it (with his hand), his face turned towards the sun.
This rule of bathing is valid for all (castes and orders).

sanskrit_iast: tasya dvaṃdvaṃ dravyāṇām eka upadiśanti pākārthabhojanārthavāsiparaśudātrakājānām |
meaning: तस्य द्वंद्वं द्रव्याणाम् एक उपदिशन्ति पाकार्थभोजनार्थवासिपरशुदात्रकाजानाम् ।
text: Some enjoin (that he shall prepare) two sets of utensils for cooking and eating, (and) of choppers, hatchets, sickles, and mallets.
He shall take one of each pair (of instruments), give the others (to his wife), and (then) go into the forest.

sanskrit_iast: tasyāraṇyenaivāta ūrdhvaṃ homo vṛttiḥ pratīkṣāc chādanaṃ ca |
meaning: तस्यारण्येनैवात ऊर्ध्वं होमो वृत्तिः प्रतीक्षाच् छादनं च ।
text: After that time (he shall perform) the burnt-oblations, (sustain) his life, (feed) his guests, and (prepare) his clothes with materials produced in the forest.

sanskrit_iast: yeṣu karmasu puroḍāśāś caravas teṣu kāryāḥ |
meaning: येषु कर्मसु पुरोडाशाश् चरवस् तेषु कार्याः ।
text: Rice must be used for those sacrifices for which cakes mixed with meat (are employed by the householder).
And all (the Mantras), as well as the daily portion of the Veda, (must be recited) inaudibly.
He shall not make the inhabitants of the forest hear (his recitation).
(He shall have) a house for his fire (only).
He himself (shall live) in the open air.
His couch and seat, must not be covered (with mats).
If he obtains fresh grain, he shall throw away the old (store).

sanskrit_iast: bhūyāṃsaṃ vā niyamam icchann anvaham eva pātreṇa sāyaṃ prātar artham āharet |
meaning: भूयांसं वा नियमम् इच्छन्न् अन्वहम् एव पात्रेण सायं प्रातर् अर्थम् आहरेत् ।
text: If he desires (to perform) very great austerities, he (shall not make a hoard of grain, but) collect food every day only, morning and evening, in his vessel.

sanskrit_iast: tato mūlaiḥ phalaiḥ parṇais tṛṇair iti vartayaṃś cared antataḥ pravṛttāni tato 'po vāyum ākāśam ity abhiniśrayet teṣām uttara uttaraḥ saṃyogaḥ phalato viśiṣṭaḥ |
meaning: ततो मूलैः फलैः पर्णैस् तृणैर् इति वर्तयंश् चरेद् अन्ततः प्रवृत्तानि ततो ऽपो वायुम् आकाशम् इत्य् अभिनिश्रयेत् तेषाम् उत्तर उत्तरः संयोगः फलतो विशिष्टः ।
text: Afterwards he shall wander about, sustaining his life with roots, fruits, leaves, and grass (which he collects). Finally (he shall content himself with) what has become detached spontaneously. Then he shall live on water, then on air, (and finally) upon ether. Each succeeding mode of subsistence procures greater rewards.
Now they quote (the following) two verses from a Purāṇa:

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi ye prajām īśirarṣayaḥ | dakṣiṇenāryamṇaḥ panthānaṃ te śmaśānāni bhejire |
meaning: अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि ये प्रजाम् ईशिरर्षयः । दक्षिणेनार्यम्णः पन्थानं ते श्मशानानि भेजिरे ।
text: Those eighty thousand sages who desired offspring passed to the south by Aryaman's road and obtained burial-grounds.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi ye prajāṃ neṣirarṣayaḥ | uttareṇāryamṇaḥ panthānaṃ te 'mṛtatvaṃ hi kalpate |
meaning: अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि ये प्रजां नेषिरर्षयः । उत्तरेणार्यम्णः पन्थानं ते ऽमृतत्वं हि कल्पते ।
text: Those eighty thousand sages who desired no offspring passed by Aryaman's road to the north and obtained immortality.
Thus are praised those who keep the vow of chastity.
Now they accomplish also their wishes merely by conceiving them,

sanskrit_iast: yathā varṣaṃ prajādānaṃ dūre darśanaṃ manojavatā yac cānyad evaṃ yuktam |
meaning: यथा वर्षं प्रजादानं दूरे दर्शनं मनोजवता यच् चान्यद् एवं युक्तम् ।
text: For instance, (the desire to procure) rain, to bestow children, second-sight, to move quick as thought, and other (desires) of this description.

sanskrit_iast: tasmāc chrutitaḥ pratyakṣaphalatvāc ca viśiṣṭān āśramān etān eke bruvate |
meaning: तस्माच् छ्रुतितः प्रत्यक्षफलत्वाच् च विशिष्टान् आश्रमान् एतान् एके ब्रुवते ।
text: Therefore on account of (passages) of the revealed texts, and on account of the visible results, some declare these orders (of men keeping the vow of chastity to be) the most excellent.

sanskrit_iast: traividyavṛddhānāṃ tu vedāḥ pramāṇam iti niṣṭhā tatra yāni śrūyante vrīhiyavapaśvājyapayaḥkapālapatnīsaṃbandhāny uccair nīcaiḥ kāryam iti tair viruddha ācāro 'pramāṇam iti manyante |
meaning: त्रैविद्यवृद्धानां तु वेदाः प्रमाणम् इति निष्ठा तत्र यानि श्रूयन्ते व्रीहियवपश्वाज्यपयःकपालपत्नीसंबन्धान्य् उच्चैर् नीचैः कार्यम् इति तैर् विरुद्ध आचारो ऽप्रमाणम् इति मन्यन्ते ।
text: But (to this we answer): It is the firm opinion of those who are well versed in the threefold sacred learning, that the Vedas are the highest authority. [paragraph continues] They consider that the (rites) which are ordered there to be performed with rice, yava, animals, clarified butter, milk, potsherds, (in conjunction) with a wife, (and accompanied) by loud or muttered (Mantras), must be performed, and that (hence) a rule of conduct which is opposed to these (rites) is of no authority.

sanskrit_iast: yat tu śmaśānam ucyate nānākarmaṇām eṣo 'nte puruṣasaṃskāro vidhīyate |
meaning: यत् तु श्मशानम् उच्यते नानाकर्मणाम् एषो ऽन्ते पुरुषसंस्कारो विधीयते ।
text: But by the term burial-ground (in the text above given) it is intended to ordain the last rites for those who have performed many sacrifices, (and not to mean that dead householders become demons and haunt burial-grounds.)

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ param anantyaṃ phalaṃ svargyaśabdaṃ śrūyate |
meaning: ततः परम् अनन्त्यं फलं स्वर्ग्यशब्दं श्रूयते ।
text: The revealed texts declare that after (the burial follows) a reward without end, which is designated by the term 'heavenly bliss.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpy asya prajātim amṛtam āmnāya āha | prajām anu prajāyase tad u te martyāmṛtam iti |
meaning: अथाप्य् अस्य प्रजातिम् अमृतम् आम्नाय आह । प्रजाम् अनु प्रजायसे तद् उ ते मर्त्यामृतम् इति ।
text: Now the Veda declares also one's offspring to be immortality (in this verse): 'In thy offspring thou art born again, that, mortal, is thy immortality.'

sanskrit_iast: athāpi sa evāyaṃ virūḍhaḥ pṛthak pratyakṣeṇopalabhyate dṛśyate cāpi sārūpyaṃ dehatvam evānyat |
meaning: अथापि स एवायं विरूढः पृथक् प्रत्यक्षेणोपलभ्यते दृश्यते चापि सारूप्यं देहत्वम् एवान्यत् ।
text: Now it can also be perceived by the senses that the (father) has been reproduced separately (in the son); for the likeness (of a father and of a son) is even visible, only (their) bodies are different.

sanskrit_iast: te śiṣṭeṣu karmasu vartamānāḥ pūrveṣāṃ sāṃparāyeṇa kīrtiṃ svargaṃ ca vardhayanti |
meaning: ते शिष्टेषु कर्मसु वर्तमानाः पूर्वेषां सांपरायेण कीर्तिं स्वर्गं च वर्धयन्ति ।
text: 'These (sons) who live, fulfilling the rites taught (in the Veda), increase the fame and heavenly bliss of their departed ancestors.'
'In this manner each succeeding (generation increases the fame and heavenly bliss) of the preceding ones.'
'They (the ancestors) live in heaven until the (next) general destruction of created things.'
At the new creation (of, the world) they become the seed. That has been declared in the Bhavishyatpurāṇa.
Now Pra g āpati also says,

sanskrit_iast: trayīṃ vidyāṃ brahmacaryaṃ prajātiṃ śraddhāṃ tapo yajñam anupradānam | ya etāni kurvate tair it saha smo rajo bhūtvā dhvaṃsate 'nyat praśaṃsann iti |
meaning: त्रयीं विद्यां ब्रह्मचर्यं प्रजातिं श्रद्धां तपो यज्ञम् अनुप्रदानम् । य एतानि कुर्वते तैर् इत् सह स्मो रजो भूत्वा ध्वंसते ऽन्यत् प्रशंसन्न् इति ।
text: 'Those dwell with us who fulfil the following (duties): the study of the three Vedas, the studentship, the procreation of children, faith, religious austerities, sacrifices, and the giving of gifts. He who praises other (duties), becomes dust and perishes.'

sanskrit_iast: tatra ye pāpakṛtas ta eva dhvaṃsanti yathā parṇaṃ vanaspater na parān hiṃsanti |
meaning: तत्र ये पापकृतस् त एव ध्वंसन्ति यथा पर्णं वनस्पतेर् न परान् हिंसन्ति ।
text: Those among these (sons) who commit sin, perish alone, just as the leaf of a tree (which has been attacked by worms falls without injuring its branch or tree). They do not hurt their ancestors.

sanskrit_iast: nāsyāsmiṃl loke karmabhiḥ saṃbandho vidyate tathā parasmin karmaphalaiḥ |
meaning: नास्यास्मिंल् लोके कर्मभिः संबन्धो विद्यते तथा परस्मिन् कर्मफलैः ।
text: (For) the (ancestor) has no connection with the acts committed (by his descendant) in this world, nor with their results in the next.
(The truth of) that may be known by the following (reason):
This creation (is the work) of Pra g āpati and of the sages.

sanskrit_iast: tatra ye puṇyakṛtas teṣāṃ prakṛtayaḥ parā jvalantya upalabhyante |
meaning: तत्र ये पुण्यकृतस् तेषां प्रकृतयः परा ज्वलन्त्य उपलभ्यन्ते ।
text: The bodies of those (sages) who stay there (in heaven) on account of their merits appear visibly most excellent and brilliant (as, for instance, the constellation of the seven Ri shis).

sanskrit_iast: syāt tu karmāvayavena tapasā vā kaścit saśarīro 'ntavantaṃ lokaṃ jayati saṃkalpasiddhiś ca syān na tu taj jyaiṣṭhyam āśramāṇām |
meaning: स्यात् तु कर्मावयवेन तपसा वा कश्चित् सशरीरो ऽन्तवन्तं लोकं जयति संकल्पसिद्धिश् च स्यान् न तु तज् ज्यैष्ठ्यम् आश्रमाणाम् ।
text: But even though some (ascetic), whilst still in the body, may gain heaven through a portion of (the merit acquired by his former) works or through austerities, and though he may. accomplish (his objects) by his mere wish, still this is no reason to place one order before the other.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātāḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ sādhāraṇavaiśeṣikā dharmāḥ | rājñas tu viśeṣād vakṣyāmaḥ |
meaning: व्याख्याताः सर्ववर्णानां साधारणवैशेषिका धर्माः । राज्ञस् तु विशेषाद् वक्ष्यामः ।

sanskrit_iast: tasya purastād āvasathas tad āmantraṇam ity ācakṣate |
meaning: तस्य पुरस्ताद् आवसथस् तद् आमन्त्रणम् इत्य् आचक्षते ।

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena puraṃ sabhā dakṣiṇodagdvārā yathobhayaṃ saṃdṛśyeta bahir antaraṃ ceti |
meaning: दक्षिणेन पुरं सभा दक्षिणोदग्द्वारा यथोभयं संदृश्येत बहिर् अन्तरं चेति ।

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ yathāguṇam āvasathāḥ śayyānnapānaṃ ca videyam |
meaning: तेषां यथागुणम् आवसथाः शय्यान्नपानं च विदेयम् ।

sanskrit_iast: na cāsya viṣaye kṣudhā rogeṇa himātapābhyāṃ vāvasīded abhāvād buddhipūrvaṃ vā kaścit |
meaning: न चास्य विषये क्षुधा रोगेण हिमातपाभ्यां वावसीदेद् अभावाद् बुद्धिपूर्वं वा कश्चित् ।

sanskrit_iast: sabhāyā madhye 'dhidevanam uddhatyāvokṣyākṣān nivaped yugmān vaibhītakān yathāarthān |
meaning: सभाया मध्ये ऽधिदेवनम् उद्धत्यावोक्ष्याक्षान् निवपेद् युग्मान् वैभीतकान् यथाअर्थान् ।
आयुधग्रहणं नृत्तगीतवादित्राणीति राजाधीनेभ्यो ऽन्यत्र न विद्येरन् ।

sanskrit_iast: kṣemakṛd rājā yasya viṣaye grāme 'raṇye vā taskarabhayaṃ na vidyate |
meaning: क्षेमकृद् राजा यस्य विषये ग्रामे ऽरण्ये वा तस्करभयं न विद्यते ।

sanskrit_iast: bhṛtyānām anuparodhena kṣetraṃ vittaṃ ca dadad brāhmaṇebhyo yathārham anantāṃl lokān abhijayati |
meaning: भृत्यानाम् अनुपरोधेन क्षेत्रं वित्तं च ददद् ब्राह्मणेभ्यो यथार्हम् अनन्तांल् लोकान् अभिजयति ।
text: A (king) who, without detriment to his servants, gives land and money to Brāhmaṇas according to their deserts gains endless worlds.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇasvāny apajigīṣamāṇo rājā yo hanyate tam āhur ātmayūpo yajño 'nantadakṣiṇa iti |
meaning: ब्राह्मणस्वान्य् अपजिगीषमाणो राजा यो हन्यते तम् आहुर् आत्मयूपो यज्ञो ऽनन्तदक्षिण इति ।
text: They say (that) a king, who is slain in attempting to recover the property of Brāhmaṇas, (performs) a sacrifice where his body takes the place of the sacrificial post, and at which an unlimited fee is given.

sanskrit_iast: etenānye śūrā vyākhyātāḥ prayojane yudhyamānās tanutyajaḥ |
meaning: एतेनान्ये शूरा व्याख्याताः प्रयोजने युध्यमानास् तनुत्यजः ।
text: Hereby have been declared (the rewards of) other heroes, who fall fighting for a (worthy) cause.

sanskrit_iast: grāmeṣu nagareṣu cāryāñ śucīn satyaśīlān prajāguptaye nidadhyāt |
meaning: ग्रामेषु नगरेषु चार्याञ् शुचीन् सत्यशीलान् प्रजागुप्तये निदध्यात् ।
text: He shall appoint men of the first three castes, who are pure and truthful, over villages and towns for the protection of the people.
Their servants shall possess the same qualities.
They must protect a town from thieves in every direction to the distance of one yo g ana.
(They must protect the country to the distance of) one krośa from each village.

sanskrit_iast: tatra yan muṣyate tais tat pratidāpyam |
meaning: तत्र यन् मुष्यते तैस् तत् प्रतिदाप्यम् ।
text: They must be made to repay what is stolen within these (boundaries).
The (king) shall make them collect the lawful taxes ( s ulka).
A learned Brāhmaṇa is free from taxes,
And the women of all castes,
And male children before the marks (of puberty appear),
And those who live (with a teacher) in order to study,
And those who perform austerities, being intent on fulfilling the sacred law,
And a Śūdra who lives by washing the feet,
Also blind, dumb, deaf, and diseased persons (as long as their infirmities last),
And those to whom the acquisition of property is forbidden (as Sannyāsins).

sanskrit_iast: abuddhipūrvam alaṃkṛto yuvā paradāram anupraviśan kumārīṃ vā vācā bādhyaḥ |
meaning: अबुद्धिपूर्वम् अलंकृतो युवा परदारम् अनुप्रविशन् कुमारीं वा वाचा बाध्यः ।
text: A young man who, decked with ornaments, enters unintentionally (a place where) a married woman or a (marriageable) damsel (sits), must be reprimanded.
But he does it intentionally with a bad purpose, he must be fined.
If he has actually committed adultery, his organ shall be cut off together with the testicles.
But (if he has had intercourse) with a (marriageable) girl, his property shall be confiscated and he shall be banished.
Afterwards the king must support (such women and damsels),
And protect them from defilement.
If they agree to undergo the (prescribed) penance, he shall make them over to their (lawful) guardians.
If (adulteresses) have performed (the prescribed penance), they are to be treated as before (their fault). For the connection (of husband and wife) takes place through the law.
(A husband) shall not make over his (wife), who occupies the position of a 'gentilis,' to others (than to his 'gentiles'), in order to cause children to be begot for himself.

sanskrit_iast: kulāya hi strī pradīyata ity upadiśanti |
meaning: कुलाय हि स्त्री प्रदीयत इत्य् उपदिशन्ति ।
text: For they declare, that a bride is given to the family (of her husband, and not to the husband alone).
That is (at present) forbidden on account of the weakness of (men's) senses.
The hand (of a gentilis is considered in law to be) that of a stranger, and so is (that of any other person except the husband).
If the (marriage vow) is transgressed, both (husband and wife) certainly go to hell.

sanskrit_iast: niyamārambhaṇo hi varṣīyān abhyudaya evam ārambhaṇād apatyāt |
meaning: नियमारम्भणो हि वर्षीयान् अभ्युदय एवम् आरम्भणाद् अपत्यात् ।
text: The reward (in the next world) resulting from obeying the restrictions of the law is preferable to offspring obtained in this manner (by means of Niyoga).
A man of one of the first three castes (who commits adultery) with a woman of the Śūdra caste shall be banished.
A Śūdra (who commits adultery) with a woman of one of the first three castes shall suffer capital punishment.
And he shall emaciate a woman who has committed adultery with a ( Śūdra, by making her undergo penances and fasts, in case she had no child).

sanskrit_iast: savarṇāyām anyapūrvāyāṃ sakṛt saṃnipāte pādaḥ patatīty upadiśanti |
meaning: सवर्णायाम् अन्यपूर्वायां सकृत् संनिपाते पादः पततीत्य् उपदिशन्ति ।
text: They declare, that (a Brāhmaṇa) who has once committed adultery with a married woman of equal class, she perform one-fourth of the penance prescribed for an outcast.
In like manner for every repetition (of the crime), one-fourth of the penance (must be added).
(If the offence be committed) for the fourth time, the whole (penance of twelve years must be performed).
The tongue of a Śūdra who speaks evil of a virtuous person, belonging to one of the first three castes, shall be cut out.

sanskrit_iast: vāci pathi śayyāyām āsana iti samībhavato daṇḍatāḍanam |
meaning: वाचि पथि शय्यायाम् आसन इति समीभवतो दण्डताडनम् ।
text: A Śūdra who assumes a position equal (to that of a member of one of the first three castes), in conversation, on the road, on a couch, in sitting (and on similar occasions), shall be flogged.

sanskrit_iast: puruṣavadhe steye bhūmyādāna iti svāny ādāya vadhyaḥ |
meaning: पुरुषवधे स्तेये भूम्यादान इति स्वान्य् आदाय वध्यः ।
text: In case (a Śūdra) commits homicide or theft, appropriates land (or commits similar heinous crimes), his property shall be confiscated and he himself shall suffer capital punishment.
But if these (offences be committed) by a Brāhmaṇa, he shall be made blind (by tying a cloth over his eyes).
He shall keep in secret confinement him who violates the rules (of his caste or order), or any other sinner, until (he promises) amendment.
If he does not amend, he shall be banished.

sanskrit_iast: ācārya ṛtvik snātako rājeti trāṇaṃ syur anyatra vadhyāt |
meaning: आचार्य ऋत्विक् स्नातको राजेति त्राणं स्युर् अन्यत्र वध्यात् ।

sanskrit_iast: kṣetraṃ parigṛhyotthānābhāvāt phalābhāve yaḥ samṛddhaḥ sa bhāvi tad apahāryaḥ |
meaning: क्षेत्रं परिगृह्योत्थानाभावात् फलाभावे यः समृद्धः स भावि तद् अपहार्यः ।
text: If a person who has taken (a lease of) land (for cultivation) does not exert himself, and hence (the land) bears no crop, he shall, if he is rich, be made to pay (to the owner of the land the value of the crop) that ought to have grown.
A servant in tillage who abandons his work shall be flogged.
The same (punishment shall be awarded) to a herdsman (who leaves his work);
And the flock (entrusted) to him shall be taken away (and be given to some other herdsman).

sanskrit_iast: hitvā vrajam ādinaḥ karśayet paśūn nātipātayet |
meaning: हित्वा व्रजम् आदिनः कर्शयेत् पशून् नातिपातयेत् ।
text: If cattle, leaving their stable, eat (the crops of other persons, then the owner of the crops, or the king's servants), may make them lean (by impounding them); (but) he shall not exceed (in such punishment).

sanskrit_iast: avarudhya paśūn māraṇe nāśane vā svāmibhyo 'vasṛjet |
meaning: अवरुध्य पशून् मारणे नाशने वा स्वामिभ्यो ऽवसृजेत् ।
text: If (a herdsman) who has taken cattle under his care, allows them to perish, or loses (them by theft, through his negligence), he shall replace them (or pay their value) to the owners.

sanskrit_iast: pramādād araṇye paśūn utsṛṣtān dṛṣṭvā grāmam ānīya svāmibhyo 'vasṛjet |
meaning: प्रमादाद् अरण्ये पशून् उत्सृष्तान् दृष्ट्वा ग्रामम् आनीय स्वामिभ्यो ऽवसृजेत् ।
text: If (the king's forester) sees cattle that have been sent into the forest through negligence (without a herdsman), he shall lead them back to the village and make them over to the owners.
If the same negligence (occur) again, he shall once impound them (and afterwards give them back).
(If the same fault be committed again) after that (second time), he shall not take care (of them).

sanskrit_iast: paraparigraham avidvān ādadāna edhodake mūle puṣpe phale gandhe grāse śāka iti vācā bādhyaḥ |
meaning: परपरिग्रहम् अविद्वान् आददान एधोदके मूले पुष्पे फले गन्धे ग्रासे शाक इति वाचा बाध्यः ।
text: He who has taken unintentionally the property of another shall be reprimanded, in case (the property be) fuel, water, roots, flowers, fruits, perfumes, fodder, or vegetables.
(If he takes the above-mentioned kinds of property) intentionally, his garment shall be taken away.

sanskrit_iast: adaṇḍyaḥ kāmakṛte tathā prāṇasaṃśaye bhojanam ādadānaḥ |
meaning: अदण्ड्यः कामकृते तथा प्राणसंशये भोजनम् आददानः ।
text: He who takes intentionally food when he is in danger of his life shall not be punished.
If the king does not punish a punishable offence, the guilt falls upon him.

sanskrit_iast: prayojayitā mantā karteti svarganarakaphaleṣu karmasu bhāginaḥ |
meaning: प्रयोजयिता मन्ता कर्तेति स्वर्गनरकफलेषु कर्मसु भागिनः ।
text: He who instigates to, he who assists in, and he who commits (an act, these three) share its rewards in heaven and its punishments in hell.
He amongst these who contributes most to the accomplishment (of the act obtains) a greater share of the result.
Both the wife and the husband have power over (their) common property.

meaning: तयोर् अनुमते ऽन्ये ऽपि तद् हितेषु वर्तेरन् ।
text: By their permission, others also may act for their good (in this and the next world, even by spending money).

sanskrit_iast: vivāde vidyābhijanasaṃpannā vṛddhā medhāvino dharmeṣv avinipātinaḥ |
meaning: विवादे विद्याभिजनसंपन्ना वृद्धा मेधाविनो धर्मेष्व् अविनिपातिनः ।
text: Men of learning and pure descent, who are aged, clever in reasoning, and careful in fulfilling the duties (of their caste and order, shall be the judges) in lawsuits.
In doubtful cases (they shall give their decision) after having ascertained (the truth) by inference, ordeals, and the like (means).

sanskrit_iast: puṇyāhe prātar agnāv iddhe 'pāmante rājavaty ubhayataḥ samākhyāpya sarvānumate mukhyaḥ satyaṃ praśnaṃ brūyāt |
meaning: पुण्याहे प्रातर् अग्नाव् इद्धे ऽपामन्ते राजवत्य् उभयतः समाख्याप्य सर्वानुमते मुख्यः सत्यं प्रश्नं ब्रूयात् ।
text: A person who is possessed of good qualities (may be called as a witness, and) shall answer the questions put to him according to the truth on an auspicious day, in the morning, before a kindled fire, standing near (a jar full of) water, in the presence of the king, and with the consent of all (of both parties and of the assessors), after having been exhorted (by the judge) to be fair to both sides.
If (he is found out speaking) an untruth, the king shall punish him.
Besides, in that case, after death, hell (will be his punishment).
If he speaks the truth, (his reward will be) heaven and the approbation of all created beings.

sanskrit_iast: sā niṣṭhā yā vidyā strīṣu śūdreṣu ca |
meaning: सा निष्ठा या विद्या स्त्रीषु शूद्रेषु च ।
text: The knowledge which Śūdras and women possess is the completion (of all study).
They declare, that (this knowledge) is a supplement of the Atharva-Veda.

sanskrit_iast: kṛcchrā dharmasamāptiḥ samāmnātena | lakṣaṇakarmaṇāt tu samāpyate |
meaning: कृच्छ्रा धर्मसमाप्तिः समाम्नातेन । लक्षणकर्मणात् तु समाप्यते ।
text: It is difficult to learn the sacred law from (the letter of) the Vedas (only); but by following the indications it is easily accomplished.

sanskrit_iast: tatra lakṣaṇam | sarvajanapadeṣv ekāntasamāhitam āryāṇāṃ vṛttaṃ samyagvinītānāṃ vṛddhānām ātmavatām alolupānām adāmbhikānāṃ vṛttasādṛśyaṃ bhajeta | evam ubhau lokāv abhijayati |
meaning: तत्र लक्षणम् । सर्वजनपदेष्व् एकान्तसमाहितम् आर्याणां वृत्तं सम्यग्विनीतानां वृद्धानाम् आत्मवताम् अलोलुपानाम् अदाम्भिकानां वृत्तसादृश्यं भजेत । एवम् उभौ लोकाव् अभिजयति ।
text: The indications for these (doubtful cases are), 'He shall regulate his course of action according to the conduct which is unanimously recognised in all countries by men of the three twice-born castes, who have been properly obedient (to their teachers), who are aged, of subdued senses, neither given to avarice, nor hypocrites. Acting thus he will gain both worlds.'

sanskrit_iast: strībhyaḥ sarvavarṇebhyaś ca dharmaśeṣān pratīyād ity eka ity eke |
meaning: स्त्रीभ्यः सर्ववर्णेभ्यश् च धर्मशेषान् प्रतीयाद् इत्य् एक इत्य् एके ।
text: Some declare, that the remaining duties (which have not been taught here) must be learnt from women and men of all castes.
